coordinateFrame.note: The quad lies in the ground plane at y=0; the origin is its centre so tiles snap on the kit grid.

referencePbr.source: the asset's own reference plate, generated as a seamless orthographic shadowless albedo swatch by the thai-ground-tile-seamless-v1 profile and shipped unaltered

runtimeContract.note: A ground tile is static level geometry. It has no moving parts, so one root pivot is the whole of its contract -- and nothing attaches to it, so it has no sockets.

textureAuthoring.note: Derived from the plate the generator actually returned rather than requested: the density a tile ships at is a property of its image, and recording the requested number instead is how a set comes to disagree with itself about its own scale.
